title: Loquacity
summary: LOQUAC'ITY, n. [L. loquacitas.] Talkativeness; the habit or practice of talking continually or excessively. Too great loquacity and too great taciturnity by fits.

inlines.v: LOQUAC'ITY, n. [L. loquacitas.] Talkativeness; the habit or practice of talking continually or excessively. Too great loquacity and too great taciturnity by fits.
